description: REQ-21's fail-closed contract explicitly covers the 記事タイプ=有料/価格=NOTE_PRICE confirmation gate (gate 3c): 'if the pre-publish state (price/type/visuals) cannot be confirmed for that exact key, it SHALL NOT click publish and SHALL report the exact blocking reason.' The three refusal branches implementing this in lib/note-publish-live.py (row_found is False at lines 196-202; paid_checked is False at lines 203-209; price_filled mismatch at lines 210-216) have ZERO dedicated test coverage. No hermetic/mocked test drives select_paid_price() to return row_found=False, paid_checked=False, or a mismatched price_filled and asserts the corresponding refusal message + non-zero exit + no-click. The only test that reaches this code at all is the live test-prop22b-live-publish-real-click.sh, which by design only exercises the ALL-CONFIRMED success path (the precheck in that test explicitly asserts eyecatch/img_count are already satisfied, and the test's own PASS condition requires rc=0 and a real click). A real-money publish tool's own price/type mismatch refusal path -- arguably the single most safety-critical branch, since a price mismatch publishing an article at the wrong price is exactly the kind of defect REQ-21 exists to prevent -- is therefore never actually verified to refuse correctly.

evidence.snippet:
